article.title: 阅读 Text 3 · 间隔年并不会让你落后
article.background: 回应高中毕业后立即升大学的社会压力，论证 gap year 不但不会妨碍学业，反而有助于适应大学、明确专业方向，并降低日后转专业的时间与金钱成本。

sentences.en: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.
sentences.zh: 如今，在一个节奏飞快、期望不断升高的世界里，社会普遍要求学生高中毕业后立刻上大学，这常常使他们完全忽视“间隔年”这一选择。

segments.text: Today, widespread social pressure to immediately go to college in conjunction with increasingly high expectations in a fast-moving world often causes students to completely overlook the possibility of taking a gap year.

sentences.en: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it?
sentences.zh: 毕竟，如果你认识的所有人秋天都要去上大学，自己却晚一年出发，看起来似乎挺傻的，不是吗？

segments.text: After all, if everyone you know is going to college in the fall, it seems silly to stay back a year, doesn't it?

sentences.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
sentences.zh: 而且，在连续上了12年学之后，花上一年去做与学业无关的事情，似乎也不太自然。

segments.text: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.

sentences.en: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.
sentences.zh: 不过，即使这些感受确实存在，也不足以成为否定间隔年的理由。

segments.text: But while this may be true, it's not a good enough reason to condemn gap years.

sentences.en: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.
sentences.zh: 在社会不断强化的这场“冲向终点的竞赛”中，人们总担心自己落在别人后面——无论终点是研究生院、医学院，还是一份高薪职业。

segments.text: There's always a constant fear of falling behind everyone else on the socially perpetuated "race to the finish line," whether that be toward graduate school, medical school or a lucrative career.

sentences.en: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits - in fact, it probably enhances it.
sentences.zh: 但与常见误解相反，间隔年并不会妨碍学业成功；事实上，它很可能还会促进学业表现。

segments.text: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits - in fact, it probably enhances it.

sentences.en: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.
sentences.zh: 美国和澳大利亚的研究表明，与没有间隔年的学生相比，选择间隔年的学生通常为大学生活准备得更充分，大学表现也更好。

segments.text: Studies from the United States and Australia show that students who take a gap year are generally better prepared for and perform better in college than those who do not.

sentences.en: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes - all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
sentences.zh: 间隔年并不会把学生拖在后面，反而会让他们提前为独立生活、新的责任和环境变化做好准备——而这些恰恰是一年级大学生最容易应付不来的事情。

segments.text: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence, new responsibilities and environmental changes - all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.

sentences.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
sentences.zh: 间隔年的经历可以缓冲进入大学、骤然置身全新环境时的冲击，使学生更容易把精力放在学业和活动上，而不是不断为适应新环境而手忙脚乱。

segments.text: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.

sentences.en: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
sentences.zh: 如果你仍不相信拿出一年探索兴趣本身就有价值，那么不妨看看它会如何影响未来学业选择所付出的经济成本。

segments.text: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.

sentences.en: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.
sentences.zh: 据美国国家教育统计中心的数据，近80%的大学生最终至少会更换一次专业。

segments.text: According to the National Center for Education Statistics, nearly 80 percent of college students end up changing their majors at least once.

sentences.en: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
sentences.zh: 这并不奇怪，因为高中阶段基础而必修的课程体系，使学生对大学里等待着他们的众多学术选择知之甚少。

segments.text: This isn't surprising, considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.

sentences.en: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
sentences.zh: 许多学生在大学申请中填的是一个专业，真正上过大学课程之后却又转向另一个专业。

segments.text: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.

sentences.en: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.
sentences.zh: 这未必是坏事，但如果转专业太晚，根据学校规定不同，补修学分可能代价不菲。

segments.text: It's not necessarily a bad thing, but depending on the school, it can be costly to make up credits after switching too late in the game.

sentences.en: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.
sentences.zh: 以波士顿学院为例，如果从其他院系转入护理学院，你就得额外读一年。

segments.text: At Boston College, for example, you would have to complete an extra year were you to switch to the nursing school from another department.

sentences.en: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
sentences.zh: 先用一个间隔年把方向想清楚，可以减少日后的压力，也能省下钱。

segments.text: Taking a gap year to figure things out initially can help prevent stress and save money later on.
